name: day-15-expense-splitter
description: Entorno TypeScript local para el divisor de gastos del día 15.

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json .gitignore README.md ROADMAP.md docs/*.md src/**/*.ts tests/**/*.mjs data/**/*.json --ignore-unknown --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json .gitignore README.md ROADMAP.md docs/*.md src/**/*.ts tests/**/*.mjs data/**/*.json --ignore-unknown --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test
